content: {"episode_id":"ep-05147","cpt":"93247","denial_carc":"PR-204","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the PR-204 denial of CPT 93247, long-term continuous ECG monitoring, for this patient who presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness in the setting of known paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and a significant history of transient ischemic attacks (G45.9, Z86.73). As the clinical indication note states, there is concern for intermittent arrhythmia contributing to cerebral hypoperfusion, and long-term continuous ECG monitoring is ordered to correlate symptoms with cardiac rhythm disturbances. The ordered study directly addresses this documented indication, and we request reconsideration of the coverage determination on the basis of this clinical necessity."}
